_comment: The reading-SELECTION baseline -- a SEPARATE experiment from the parse baseline (baseline.json). The parse baseline gates the GRAMMAR + lexicon: what forest is produced (the pins ask whether the correct STRUCTURE survives). THIS file gates the RANKER: which reading gets chosen from that forest, scored READING-level (structure + word senses) against the adjudication ledger. Different re-baselining triggers: grammar work re-draws the parse baseline without touching this file; a new selection draw, a prompt change, or a ledger revision re-derives THIS baseline without touching the parse numbers. Update deliberately, never to make a red run go green.

provenance.date: 2026-08-17 (D69 slice 3 — the measurement the note exists to produce)
provenance.forest: ranks experiments/parsing/ranks/2026-08-17-d70b.json, RE-RECORDED live on this snapshot. The prior draw (2026-08-13-d69-corrected) replayed 61/62 against d70b — D70 changed candidate sense lists (new `name` entries, recovered T033 mass entries) so one rank key no longer matched. Per the protocol (experiments/parsing/README.md §3) 'a replay with misses > 0 is a different experiment, not a reproduction', so the draw was re-recorded rather than scored through.
provenance.reproduction: the live run and its replay agree EXACTLY — replay 62 hits/0 misses, selection replay 40 hits/0 misses, readings 613, skeletons 170, 30/10/0 both ways.
provenance.ledger: reading-adjudications.tsv — all 16 novel decisions adjudicated 2026-08-17; reading-unadjudicated is 0, so this is a measurement and not a partial count.
provenance.note: THE D69 QUESTION ANSWERED. The 2026-08-11 baseline (21/31 = 68%) scored a ranker that could not SEE its options: for «MSI cancer models did not have the exonuclease activity of WRN» the prompt carried 120 candidates with 120 distinct sems as only 4 DISTINCT STRINGS. With the Expanded register, the concept legend and the injectivity guard in place — and after the sense-cap rework, the hyphen fix, the frozen-failure fix, the atom overrides and D70 — it is 30/40 = 75%. The eligible set GREW 31 -> 40 because the discourse loop now closes units that used to parse Open, so the fractions are over different populations; the comparable statement is per-decision accuracy, 68% -> 75%, with the population change named. Structure diagnostic 23/31 -> 33/40 (74% -> 83%). Blindness was therefore PART of the earlier error and not all of it: 10 decisions are still wrong with the pool fully visible, which is what slice 4 (D69-B, two-level presentation + logged truncation) addresses next.

gates.reading_unadjudicated: GATED: must be 0 on the tracked replay -- an unadjudicated decision makes the number a partial count, not a measurement; a new draw choosing novel readings fails until its ledger rows are adjudicated (mirrors audit-skeletons).
gates.invalid_selected: GATED: must be 0 (SELECTION-VALIDITY). The ranker has no kernel veto -- every candidate type-checks -- so the ledger and this validity check are its controls.
gates.structure_correct: diagnostic only -- reported, never gated; the pins belong to the parse baseline's faithfulness gate.

_provenance_note_2026-08-22b-production-: RE-MEASURED after the #210/#205 close-out (2026-08-22, commit a05cfa1, snapshot wordnet-umls-aligned-2026-08-22c). Tracked draw: ranks/2026-08-22-productiontrace.json, selections/2026-08-22-productiontrace-live.json. Live and replay AGREE. Coverage: grammar-gap 0, expected-hits 62/62, miss-set unchanged, skeletons 170 (unchanged). Selection: 41 eligible, 30 correct, 0 unadjudicated, 0 invalid-selected — reading-correct 30/40 -> 30/41, holds. total-readings 613 -> 674, ungated and inside the 700 ceiling. ONE ADJUDICATION was needed to reach 0 unadjudicated: «The MSI relationship compared favourably…» chose a reading structurally IDENTICAL to two rows already ruled `wrong` for that unit (the conjunction split, hanging «for vulnerabilities» on the subject), and wrong on both contested sense axes besides. Recorded `wrong`. METHOD, after getting it wrong earlier the same day: a single live run is a DRAW, not a measurement. Draw until clean (up to 3), PROMOTE the clean draw to ranks/, replay it to confirm live and replay agree, and only then read the numbers. Four earlier draws that day reported 61 hits twice on DIFFERENT sentences; two of them carried malformed sense-ranker replies (eigenius#212), and none had been promoted. Check `grep -c 'malformed reply'` before attributing any delta to code.
